text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Based on consultation between Transportation Services staff, Councillor Ana Bailão and residents on Russett Avenue, it was determined that the installation of traffic calming should not proceed on Russett Avenue, between Bloor Street West and Wallace Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its June 6, 2018 meeting.
